query: Please implement an instant messaging APP for group and private chats. Users should be able to send text, voice, video, images, emojis, red packets, locations, files, and business cards. The APP should have a social circle feature where users can share their life updates. Users should be able to engage in group chats and private chats, sending various types of messages. Assign cotton to the background and maroon to the UI elements.
